roles.name: architect
roles.instruction: Design the smallest production-safe implementation. Identify interfaces, invariants, and failure modes.

roles.name: builder
roles.instruction: Turn the task into concrete Node.js, JSON, and PowerShell implementation steps. Prefer deterministic code.

roles.name: critic
roles.instruction: Attack the proposed design. Look for security, silo leakage, hallucinated external APIs, nondeterminism, and unsafe publication.

synthesis: Produce a final implementation plan that reconciles the three reports. Do not invent external APIs. Preserve approval_required=true and publish_allowed=false unless a human explicitly changes those gates.
